assets.name: ネアンデルタール人とオル
assets.subject: One original fully clothed adult Neanderthal hunter, natural stocky powerful human anatomy, broad chest, short robust lower limbs, subtle broad nose and brow, upright dignified posture, short dark beard, brown hair tied compactly. Fitted grey-brown hide tunic ending above the knees, compact fur shoulders, belt, ankle boots, small cream shoulder cloth accent. Empty hands. Symmetrical relaxed A-pose with both arms separated 35 degrees from torso, fingers readable, knees and elbows visible, legs apart. Full body, near-frontal view with at most 10 degrees three-quarter turn, both feet visible.

assets.name: マンモス
assets.subject: One anatomically believable woolly mammoth, warm dark brown thick fur in compact clean masses, high shoulder hump, domed head, small ears, two complete ivory tusks curving forward and upward with clear space between tusks and trunk. Trunk hangs almost straight with a gentle tip curl, visibly separated from chest and tusks. All four sturdy legs and complete flat feet visible and separated in a neutral standing pose. Small tail visible. Full animal, moderate three-quarter side view facing left, no overlapping legs, no vegetation, no rock or base.

assets.name: 針葉樹
assets.subject: One complete mature evergreen Scots pine tree, tall slightly tapering textured brown trunk, naturally irregular dense green needle boughs arranged in readable compact masses, clear lower trunk and grounded root collar, asymmetrical natural silhouette, upright. Broad branch tiers taper toward the tip without looking like geometric cones. Clean believable MMORPG environment asset. Full tree visible from root to highest tip; no terrain, pot, pedestal, grass, other tree or falling needles.

assets.name: 草の株
assets.subject: One compact rooted tuft of wild meadow grass, many gently bending medium-width grass blades with believable thickness, muted olive green and straw-yellow tips, clean grouped leaf masses and small dense root crown. Low irregular rounded tuft suitable for repeating on a game meadow. Complete object with open readable silhouette. No flower, soil slab, pot, rocks, surrounding field or pedestal. Three-quarter view slightly above ground.

assets.name: 岩と石資源
